name: Signal Cluster S51: Gap Analysis (Bar Gap on Daily)
description: Tests: bar_gap(fill_percent, min_gap_size) on daily bars. Session_gap requires intraday — tested in signal_cluster_intraday_validation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S51: Bar Gap on Daily
# session_gap requires intraday — see signal_cluster_intraday_validation
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# === BAR GAP (works on any timeframe) ===
bg = bar_gap(fill_percent=100, min_gap_size=0.1)(o=src.o, h=src.h, l=src.l, c=src.c)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Bar Gap Size (%)',
    category='Gaps',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gap Size', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=bg.gap_size)

xy_lines(
    title='Gap Retrace',
    category='Gaps',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Retrace', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=bg.gap_retrace)
